text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and Stock D at gains felt rewarding, but a gain relative to my cost is not by itself a reason to sell; I should weigh each holding’s role and risk in the portfolio.","My account fell in Period 5 despite those sales, reminding me that trimming winners does not ensure protection from losses elsewhere.","Because past price moves do not predict future moves, I should avoid reacting to short-term changes and make deliberate decisions consistent with diversification and my long-term plan."]}
